v0.1.0.title: Astral Ascent APworld v0.1.0

v0.2.0.description:
Small update to the original 0.1.0 version to optimize/fix a few things for more "beatable" seeds.

I was noticing that Sire Bapy achievements are so wide in how "doable" they are that simply organizing them by tier was too broad.
The goal with this update is to give more tweak options in order to be able to have deeper achievement tiers in some achievements and eliminate other ones without having to individually exclude them.

To facilitate this and futher improve YAML creation, the options have been reorganized and expanded.
v0.2.0.title: Astral Ascent APworld and Randomizer v0.2.0
